name: Dead Man's Bot
author: Knock
summary: Runs a user-armed dead-man's switch that releases a chosen payload only after a missed check-in.
starterPrompt: Help me design a safe dead-man's switch. Start by asking what check-in interval I want and what payload should be released.
usageNote: Use only with non-destructive payloads you control. Test with harmless data before arming, and review every recipient and trigger.
